answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a per-identity bond escrowed on-ledger before an agent earns weight. Rewards accrue only to bonded identities, so a farm of N fakes costs N full bonds plus slashing risk, not one signup fee. A mandatory proof-of-work beacon adds a second toll: compute or stake per clone. Clones earn no extra payout since weight is capped by the bond, and a gale of new accounts burns capital faster than it gains influence. Each clone's signal is discounted, so coalition gain stays near zero while the attacker pays full price. Honest agents post one bond and recover it.
